unit: 语态进阶 · 各时态的被动语态
summary: 高中聚焦各时态的被动：将来时被动 will be done、进行时被动 is being done、完成时被动 has been done，以及不定式被动与主动表被动。

rules.title: 将来时被动：will be + 过去分词
rules.detail: will be done（am/is/are going to be done 同理）。主语是将来的动作承受者时使用。

examples.en: The plan will be discussed at the meeting tomorrow afternoon.
examples.zh: 这个计划将在明天下午的会上被讨论。

examples.en: A new library will be built in our school next year.
examples.zh: 明年我们学校将建一座新图书馆。

rules.title: 进行时被动：is/are being + 过去分词
rules.detail: 表示「正在被做」。结构中的 being 千万不能丢。

examples.en: The road is being repaired now, so we have to take another way.
examples.zh: 道路正在维修，我们得绕路走。

examples.en: The environment problem is being discussed at the meeting.
examples.zh: 环境问题正在会上被讨论。

rules.title: 完成时被动：has/have been + 过去分词
rules.detail: 表示「已经被做」。have/has 和 been 缺一不可。

examples.en: The work has been finished already.
Many trees have been planted along the river since last year.
examples.zh: 去年以来河边种了许多树。

rules.title: 不定式被动与主动表被动
rules.detail: 不定式被动 to be done：There is a lot of work to be done.；sell / write / wash / read 等动词与 well、easily 等副词连用时主动表被动：The pen writes smoothly.（这支笔写起来顺滑）

examples.en: There are many problems to be solved.
This kind of cloth washes well and sells well.

pitfalls: 进行时被动丢 being：❌ The road is repaired now.（正被修）→ ✓ The road is being repaired now.
完成时被动丢 been：❌ The work has finished already.（工作「被」完成）→ ✓ The work has been finished already.
主动表被动误加被动：❌ The pen is written smoothly. → ✓ The pen writes smoothly.

compare.right: 被动形式（以 do 为例）

rows.l: 一般现在 / 一般过去时

questions.stem: The plan ___ at the meeting tomorrow afternoon.
questions.explain: plan 是「被讨论」，tomorrow 是将来，用将来时被动 will be discussed。

questions.stem: — Can I take my bike back now? — Sorry, it ___ at the moment.
questions.explain: at the moment 表示「此刻正被修理」，用进行时被动 is being repaired。

questions.stem: All the preparations for the task ___, and we're ready to start.
questions.explain: preparations「被完成」；and we're ready 说明对现在的影响，用现在完成时被动 have been completed。

questions.stem: — Do you like the material? — Yes, it ___ very soft.
questions.explain: feel 是系动词，没有被动语态，主动形式 feels 表示「摸起来」。

questions.stem: There are a lot of problems ___ at the meeting.
questions.explain: problems 是「被讨论」的对象且尚未发生，用不定式被动 to be discussed。

questions.stem: A new hospital ___ (build) in our town next year.
questions.explain: hospital「被建」+ next year 将来，用将来时被动 will be built。

questions.stem: Look! The house ___ (paint) by the workers now.
questions.explain: Look! + now 表示「正被刷漆」，用进行时被动 is being painted。

questions.stem: The road is repaired now, so we have to take another way.
questions.explain: now 说明「正在被修」，进行时被动必须带 being：is being repaired。

questions.stem: 明年我们学校将建一座新的教学楼。（翻译整句）
answer: a new teaching building will be built in our school next year.
a new classroom building will be built in our school next year.
questions.explain: 教学楼「被建」+ next year 将来，用将来时被动 will be built。
